question: How many customers are there?
How many orders are in each status?
referenceSql: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: What was the total revenue in 2025?
referenceSql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Show revenue for each month of 2024, in month order.
referenceSql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND o.ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at)

question: Which 5 products have the most units ordered, counting all orders regardless of status?
referenceSql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers live in each country?
referenceSql: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: What is the average review rating for each product category, rounded to two decimals?
referenceSql: SELECT c.name, round(avg(r.rating), 2) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: What percentage of all orders were cancelled? Round to two decimals.
referenceSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / count(*), 2) FROM orders

question: How many customers signed up in 2025?
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Which city has the most orders?
referenceSql: SELECT c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many products have a list price above 200?
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price > 200

question: What is the most expensive product in each category?
referenceSql: SELECT c.name, p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.price = (SELECT max(price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id)

question: On average, how many units are in an order? Round to two decimals.
referenceSql: SELECT round(avg(units), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity) AS units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: List the email addresses of the 5 customers who spent the most.
referenceSql: SELECT c.email FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How much money was refunded in total, based on the items in refunded orders?
referenceSql: SELECT sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'refunded'

question: How many reviews are there for each star rating?
referenceSql: SELECT rating, count(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY rating

question: How many customers have placed more than 5 orders?
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 5) t

question: What is the average list price of products in each category, rounded to two decimals?
referenceSql: SELECT c.name, round(avg(p.price), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name
